parameters.name: consumerAuthorizationRuleId
parameters.description: The consumer authorization rule ID used to filter the operation list. The response includes only operations that are authorized by the specified rule.

parameters.name: forDeploy
parameters.description: Specifies whether the request is for a deployment scenario.

parameters.name: httpApiId
parameters.description: The ID of the target HTTP API.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Searches for operations by exact name match.

parameters.name: nameLike
parameters.description: Searches for operations by name prefix.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number, starting from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: pathLike
parameters.description: Searches for operations by path prefix match.

parameters.name: withConsumerInEnvironmentId
parameters.description: The environment ID. When specified together with withConsumerInfoById, the response includes the authorization rule list of the specified consumer in the specified environment for each operation.

parameters.name: withConsumerInfoById
parameters.description: The consumer ID. When specified together with withConsumerInEnvironmentId, the response includes the authorization rule list of the specified consumer in the specified environment for each operation.

parameters.name: withPluginAttachmentByPluginId
parameters.description: The plugin ID used to retrieve plugin deployment information.
